deposit_routed_through_preview_mint.meaning: a deposit is processed through the vault's previewMint path

asset_exit_available_after_deposit.meaning: an asset-based previewWithdraw exit can still be completed after the previewMint-routed deposit (negation of the reported permanent DoS for asset exits)

asset_exits_permanently_dosed_after_depo.meaning: the vault is permanently DoSed for all asset-based previewWithdraw exits after processing a previewMint-routed deposit

assumptions: The deposit routed through previewMint is the checked operation; its caller and permission status are not stated.
The reported DoS is scoped to asset-based previewWithdraw exits only, not to all vault functions.

unresolved.description: The report does not state the concrete deposit amount or state walk that triggers the permanent DoS; only an illustrative SLOPE=2e18 walk is mentioned, so no numeric trigger is bound.
The report does not state who may call previewMint or whether the deposit is permissionless, so no caller/authorization qualifier is encoded.

limitations: The exit-availability observable is a report-grounded Boolean because the report states the DoS condition qualitatively without a numeric exit threshold.
The invariant totalAssets == HALF_SLOPE * square(totalShares) is not encoded here; this plan formalizes only the selected DoS impact, not the invariant relation.
